full_judgment: 15. Mr. Rokonuddin Mahmood further submits that the damage claimed in the present suit is too remote. He has referred to the plaint of this suit, where the business loss was shown purely on presumption, assumption and speculation. Since there was no business at all of the aforesaid joint venture company, the assessment of damage of business loss cannot arise at all. Mr. Mahmood submits that simply on the analysis of comparing with the business of the other fishing companions, this damage has been assessed and such type of damage is too remote. If the damage is too remote, the affected person cannot claim any damage. The profit shown in the plaint is only speculative. On such a speculative damage the court cannot give an effective decree in view of the fact that the alleged profit has no basis at all.
